title: Lantern Caves
brief: Steer a lantern-bearer with the joystick through three caves, collecting crystals and dodging bats and a chasing wisp to reach each exit; three lives, the last cave ends at the heart crystal.

title: Castle Keys
brief: Step a knight through four castle floors with the d-pad: take the key, open the door, slip past patrolling guards to the stairs and finally the throne; three lives.

title: Frost Peaks
brief: A side-view mountain climb in three levels: tap jump pads to hop up one-way ledges past falling icicles and rolling snowballs to the flag, then the summit; three lives.

title: Sky Courier
brief: Fly a paper plane up a tall scrolling sky with the joystick, grab the parcel and reach the tower while gulls, a storm cloud and a chaser hunt you; two levels, three lives.

title: Orchard Defender
brief: Tap falling crows (and tougher swoopers and ravens) before they hit the ground; the score gates three orchards, each harder, and losing all four lives ends it.

title: Reef Diver
brief: Swim across three wide scrolling reefs with the joystick past coral, jellyfish, eels and a chasing shark, grabbing pearls, to the gate and finally the treasure chest; three lives.

title: Warehouse Porter
brief: Push crates onto their green slots one tap-step at a time through three halls with growing crate counts; filling every slot of a hall opens the next, the last hall wins.

title: Ghost Manor
brief: Sneak a kid through three haunted floors with the joystick: pick up the key, unlock the door, avoid patrolling and chasing ghosts to reach the stairs and the final exit; three lives.

title: Space Gates
brief: Drag a ship sideways to dodge falling rocks and comets for a fixed time in each of three sectors, with faster waves each time; survive the last timer to win, three lives.

title: Slime Arena
brief: Slimes crawl toward your crystal; tap them to pop them (brutes take three taps, splitters burst into slimes). Enough pops clear each of three arenas; the crystal shattering loses.

title: Pond Hopper
brief: Hop a frog with the d-pad across three ponds past dragonflies, turtles and a heron to the lily pad in each; three lives, the last pad wins the game.
